A Thief is marked [Thief: 0%]. It steals from every monster killed near it, and its bag fills up: watch the number grow in its title.

When you kill a Thief, it drops its adena many times over - the fuller the bag, the bigger the prize. A full bag pays about twenty times the usual adena.

Tip: next time, let it watch you hunt for a while, then strike. But don't wait too long - at night a Thief with a full bag runs off into the dark.
